description:
Updates the body or category of an existing job application note. Both body and category are required — the backend replaces the full note on update.

If the user only mentions updating the body and doesn't specify a category, infer the best-fit category from the note content using this mapping:
  • text_message — contact via SMS/text
  • email_external — contact via email
  • call — phone or video call
  • linkedin_connection_request — sent or received a LinkedIn connection request
  • linkedin_message — direct message on LinkedIn
  • coffee_chat — informational interview or coffee chat
  • in_person_meeting — face-to-face meeting
  • networking_event — conference, meetup, career fair, or similar event
  • referral — someone referred the user or made an introduction
  • other — genuinely doesn't fit any of the above

If ambiguous, ask the user to confirm before calling. Use list_job_application_notes to retrieve the note UUID if you don't have it.

application_id.description: UUID of the job application this note belongs to.

category.description: Category tag for the note. Use a slug from the tool description (e.g. 'call', 'in_person_meeting'). Display labels like 'Call' or 'In-Person Meeting' are also accepted.

note_uuid.description: UUID of the note to update. Returned by add_job_application_note or list_job_application_notes.

name: update_job_application_note
